Rashi on Niddah 11a:11:1.hebrew: מתוך ימי זיבתה - כגון, ראתה בראש חודש, וחזרה וראתה בט"ו לחודש, כשעומדת בימים שהיא ראויה לזיבה, דהיינו י"א יום שבין נדה לנדה, וחזרה וראתה בראש חודש ובט"ו לחודש, וחזרה וראתה בט"ו לחודש ולא ראתה בראש חודש שלפניו, שקבעה לה וסת לט"ו בחודש. ומצטרפין תרתי ראיות דימי זיבה להך ראייה לקביעות וסת:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:11:1.english: During the days of her zivah [status] - For example, she saw [blood] on the first of the month, and again saw on the fifteenth of the month, while she is within the days when she is fit to [have] zivah [status], namely the eleven days between one menstruation and the next; and again she saw on the first of the month and on the fifteenth of the month; and again she saw on the fifteenth of the month and did not see on the first of the month preceding it — so that she has established a fixed cycle for the fifteenth of the month. And the two sightings of the zivah days combine with this [third] sighting to establish a fixed cycle.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:11:2.hebrew: ואין אשה קובעת לה וסת בימי נדתה - כגון ראתה בראש חודש, וחזרה וראתה בחמישי בחודש — דהיינו בימי נדות — וחזרה וראתה עוד פעמים בחמישי בחודש, לא קבעה וסת. שאין ראיית ימי נדה ראייה לקבוע, שהיא עלולה לראות בימי נדותה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:11:2.english: And a woman does not establish a fixed cycle during the days of her menstruation - For example, if she saw [blood] on the first of the month, and again saw on the fifth of the month — that is, during the days of menstrual impurity — and again saw [blood] on the fifth of the month several more times, she has not established a fixed cycle. For seeing [blood] during the days of menstruation is not a valid sighting for establishing [a cycle], since she is liable to see [blood] during the days of her menstrual impurity.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:11:3.hebrew: שפיר - קתני במתניתין דלא בעיא בדיקה, דאי לטמויי — טמאה היא, ואי לקבוע וסת ולידע אם תשנה וסת שלשה פעמים ליום אחר שאינה למודה עד עכשיו — הא אמרת דלא קבעה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:11:3.english: Well - It is taught in the mishnah that she does not need to examine herself. For if [the examination is] to render her impure — she is [already] impure; and if [it is] to establish a fixed cycle, and to know whether she will change the cycle three times to another day, which she was not accustomed to until now — but you have said that she did not establish [a cycle]:

Rashi on Niddah 11a:12:1.hebrew: ממעין סתום - כדמפרש אליבא דר' יוחנן בשילהי פ' בנות כותים (לקמן נדה דף לט:), כגון דחזאי ריש ירחא, וריש ירחא, ועשרים וחמשה, וריש ירחא, דהוה ראייה בתרייתא בימי נדותה, דאפילו הכי הוה קביעות וסת בריש ירחא, כדמפרש התם דאמר: וסתה בריש ירחא קבעה. והא דאקדים וחזאי, דמים יתירי איתוספו בה, דהא ודאי קבעה, משום דתחילת הוסת הוחזק ממעין סתום, וגם ראייה אחרונה חשבינן לה כמעין סתום, כדאמר: הא דאקדים וחזאי תוספת דמים הוא. אבל ממעין פתוח, כגון שהראיות הראשונות של וסת יהו בתוך ימי נדה כי מתניתין (דלא מיירי בתחלת נדה, דהא לא מפליג בה מידי, אלא סתמא קתני חוץ מן הנדה), הילכך לא בעיא בדיקה בימי נדות, שהרי נפתח מעינה, ואפילו היא רואה לא תקבע וסת. לישנא אחרינא: ממעין סתום, שראתה היום ופסקה, וחזרה וראתה ברביעי או בחמישי לנדתה. אבל ממעין פתוח, כגון שלא פסקה, וראתה א' ב' ג' ד' לחודש, וראתה פעם שניה בד' בחודש, וכן שלישית, לא מהניא ראייה דרביעי בחודש דנדות קמא למיקבע. ומתניתין במעיין פתוח, וראשון ישר בעיני:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:12:1.english: From a stopped source - As [the Gemara] explains according to Rabbi Yoḥanan at the end of the chapter [entitled] Benot Kutim (below, Niddah 39b): for example, where she saw [blood] at the beginning of the month, and [again at] the beginning of the month, and on the twenty-fifth, and [again at] the beginning of the month, so that the last sighting was during the days of her menstruation. Even so, there was a fixed cycle on the beginning of the month, as it explains there, where [Rabbi Yoḥanan] says: She established her cycle at the beginning of the month. And as for the fact that she saw earlier, additional blood was added to her; for surely she established [the cycle], because the start of the cycle was established from a stopped source, and we also regard the last sighting as from a stopped source, as [the Gemara] says: That which she saw earlier is an addition of blood. But [from] an open source — for example, where the first sightings of the cycle are within the days of menstruation, as in our Mishnah (which does not discuss the start of menstruation, for it makes no distinction regarding it, but teaches simply "other than the menstruant") — therefore she does not need to examine herself during the days of her menstruation, since her source has been opened, and even if she sees [blood], she does not establish a cycle. Another explanation: From a stopped source, [meaning] that she saw today and stopped, and returned and saw on the fourth or fifth day of her menstruation. But from an open source, for example, where she did not stop and saw [blood] on the first, second, third, [and] fourth of the month, and saw a second time on the fourth of the month, and likewise a third time, the sighting of the fourth of the month does not help to establish [a cycle] because of the first menstruation. And our Mishnah is [speaking] of an open source. And the first [explanation] seems right to me.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:13:1.hebrew: מבקשת לישב - כשכלין ימי לידה, כגון בשביעי לזכר, או יום י"ד לנקבה, לא בעיא בדיקה, דהא אפילו אינה רואה היא טמאה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:13:1.english: Seeking to sit - When the days of childbirth [impurity] end, for example on the seventh day for a male [birth], or on the fourteenth day for a female [birth], she does not need an examination, since even if she sees nothing she is impure.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:1.hebrew: הניחא לרב דאמר - מעין אחד הוא, בפרק בנות כותים (לקמן נדה דף לה:):
Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:1.english: This works out well according to Rav, who said - [that it is one source], in the chapter Benot Kutim (below, Niddah 35b):

Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:2.hebrew: מעין אחד הוא - דם הבא בתוך ז' של לידה, ודם הבא לאחר שבעה, ממעין אחד הוא:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:2.english: It is one source - The blood that comes within the seven [days] of birth and the blood that comes after the seven [days] are from one source.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:3.hebrew: התורה טמאתו - תוך שבעה לזכר, וי"ד לנקבה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:3.english: The Torah deemed it impure - within seven [days] for a male [birth], and fourteen [days] for a female [birth]:

Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:4.english: And the Torah declared it pure - [Throughout] all the days of purity.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:5.hebrew: שפיר - קתני מתניתין דלא בעיא בדיקה, דהא בין פסקה ובין לא פסקה, טמאה היום וטהורה למחר:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:5.english: It is well - The mishna teaches that she does not require an examination, for whether she stopped [bleeding] or did not stop, she is impure today and pure tomorrow.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:15:1.hebrew: אלא ללוי דאמר שני מעיינות הן - נפתח הטמא כל ימי הלידה ונסתם הטהור, ולסוף שבעה לזכר וי"ד לנקבה נסתם הטמא ונפתח הטהור. ואוקימנא התם, דשופעת מתוך שבעה לאחר שבעה ס"ל ללוי דאפילו בשמיני לעולם היא טמאה עד שתפסוק, דהא לא נסתם הטמא. תבדוק בשביעי, דילמא וכו':
Rashi on Niddah 11a:15:1.english: Rather, according to Levi, who said there are two sources - The impure [source] is open all the days of childbirth and the pure [source] is closed, and at the end of seven [days] for a male and fourteen for a female, the impure [source] is closed and the pure [source] is opened. And we established there that [in the case of a woman] who discharges continuously from within the seven [days] into after the seven, Levi holds that even on the eighth [day] she remains impure indefinitely until she stops [flowing], since the impure [source] did not close. [Therefore,] let her examine [herself] on the seventh [day], lest etc.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:2:1.english: She jumped - [The jumping] is considered a circumstance of compulsion [i.e., an external cause, and not her natural cycle]:

Rashi on Niddah 11a:2:2.hebrew: קפצה וראתה - ג' פעמים, קבעה לה וסת, כדמפרש ואזיל:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:2:2.english: She jumped and saw - Three times; she has established a fixed cycle for herself, as [the Gemara] explains as it proceeds.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:2:3.hebrew: אילימא לימים - כגון קפצה באחד בשבת וראתה, וקפצה באחד בשבת וראתה, וכן שלישית — קבעה לה וסת באחד בשבת. וכל זמן שתראה עוד באחד בשבת, ואפילו בלא קפיצה, דיה שעתה. ואם הגיע אחד בשבת ולא בדקה עצמה, טמאה מספק, דאורח בזמנו הוא בא כל יומא באחד בשבת:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:2:3.english: If we say [that she established a cycle] of days - For example, she jumped on Sunday and saw [blood], and jumped on Sunday and saw [blood], and likewise a third time — she has established for herself a fixed cycle on Sunday. And whenever she sees [blood] again on Sunday, even without jumping, her [impurity from] the time [of seeing] is sufficient. And if Sunday arrived and she did not examine herself, she is impure due to doubt, since [the blood] comes at its [usual] time by its [regular] course — every day, on Sunday.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:2:4.hebrew: דלא קפיץ לא חזאי - אלמא, לאו וסתה הוא:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:2:4.english: That she did not jump, she did not see - Evidently, it is not her [fixed] cycle.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:3:1.hebrew: אלא לקפיצות - כיון דראתה שלש פעמים על ידי קפיצה, הורגלה לראיית קפיצה, ובכל יום שתקפוץ מחזקינן לה ברואה. ואם לא בדקה, טמאה, ואפילו שאר ימות שבת:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:3:1.english: Rather, [the cycle is established] by jumping - Since she saw [blood] three times by means of jumping, she has become accustomed to seeing [blood] from jumping, and on any day that she jumps we presume her to be seeing [blood]. And if she did not examine herself, she is impure, even on the other days of the week:

Rashi on Niddah 11a:4:1.hebrew: לימים ולקפיצות - כל אחד בשבת שתקפוץ, מחזקינן לה ברואה, דזמנה הוא לראות באחד בשבת על ידי קפיצה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:4:1.english: For days and for jumps - Each [time] on Sunday that she jumps, we presume her to be seeing [blood], for her time to see [blood] is on Sunday by means of jumping.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:4:2.english: [A cycle] of days alone — obvious - Since she has not established [a cycle].

Rashi on Niddah 11a:5:1.hebrew: דיומא הוא דקא גרים - ויהא באחד בשבת וסתה, אפילו בלא קפיצה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:5:1.english: It was the day that caused it - And her set time [vestah] would be on Sunday, even without jumping:

Rashi on Niddah 11a:5:2.hebrew: קמ"ל - הא דאמר דלא קבעה וסת לימים, דקפיצה דאתמול גרמה לראייה דהאידנא, ואין לה וסת באחד בשבת בלא קפיצה, ולא לקפיצה בלא אחד בשבת, מדלא חזיא מאתמול:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:5:2.english: It teaches us - This [is the meaning of] what [the Gemara] said, that she has not established a set cycle for [specific] days: the jumping of yesterday caused today's sighting. She has no set cycle for Sunday without jumping, nor for jumping without Sunday, since she did not see [blood] yesterday [right after the jumping].

Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:1.hebrew: אע"פ שאמרו דיה שעתה - באשה שיש לה וסת:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:1.english: Although they said, "Her time is sufficient" - [this refers] to a woman who has a fixed menstrual cycle.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:2.hebrew: צריכה להיות בודקת - בכל יום, שחרית וערבית, כשאר נשים:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:2.english: She must be examining herself - Every day, morning and evening, like other women.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:3.hebrew: חוץ מן הנדה - משראתה יום אחד, טמאה שבעה, ואינה צריכה בדיקה כל שבעה, שהרי בלא ראייה היא טמאה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:3.english: Except for a menstruating woman - From the time she sees [blood] one day, she is impure for seven [days], and she does not need to examine herself throughout the seven [days], since even without seeing [blood] she is impure:

Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:4.hebrew: והיושבת על דם טוהר - דלמה לה בדיקה? אפילו תראה דם, טהורה היא:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:7:4.english: And one who is sitting in the blood of purity - For why does she need examination? Even if she sees blood, she is pure.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:8:1.hebrew: ומשמשת בעדים - אע"פ שיש לה וסת, צריכה לשמש בעדים, ולבדוק לפני תשמיש ולאחר תשמיש:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:8:1.english: And she engages in intercourse with examination cloths - Even though she has a fixed cycle, she must engage in intercourse using examination cloths, and examine herself before intercourse and after intercourse.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:8:2.hebrew: ובתולה שדמיה טהורין - ד' לילות. דהיא אינה צריכה לשמש בעדים, שהרי דמה טהור, ואפילו נשתנו מראה דמיה, הואיל ושמשה, אמרינן דמשום תשמיש נשתנה. אבל שחרית וערבית, היכא דלא שמשה אחר בעילה ראשונה, צריכה בדיקה, כדמפרש בגמרא, שמא נשתנו מראה דמים שלה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:8:2.english: And a virgin whose blood is pure - [For] four nights. For she does not need to engage in intercourse with examination cloths, since her blood is pure, and even if the appearance of her blood changed, since she had intercourse, we say that it changed because of the intercourse. But in the morning and evening, where she did not have intercourse after the first act of intercourse, she requires examination, as [the Gemara] explains, lest the appearance of her blood have changed.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:9:1.hebrew: ופעמים צריכה להיות בודקת - כל אשה:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:9:1.english: And at times she must be examining - Every woman.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:9:2.hebrew: שחרית ובין השמשות - שחרית, להכשיר טהרות של לילה; ערבית, להכשיר טהרות של יום, כדאמרינן טעמא בריש פירקין:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:9:2.english: In the morning and at twilight - In the morning, to validate the [handling of] pure items [that took place] during the night; in the evening, to validate [the handling of] pure items [that took place] during the day, as we stated the reason at the beginning of the chapter.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:9:3.english: To engage in intercourse with her household - With her husband.

Tosafot on Niddah 11a:12:1.hebrew: ממעין סתום - פירש רש"י: כגון דחזאי ריש ירחא וריש ירחא וכ"ה בירחא וריש ירחא; ומעין פתוח כגון שהראיות הראשונות של וסת היו בתוך ימי נדה (או כ"ה בירחא וריש ירחא), או ריש ירחא וה' בירחא, וכן בשניה ובשלישית חזאי חמש בירחא ולא חזאי ריש ירחא. וא"ת: ולרב פפא דמפרש שילהי בנות כותים (לקמן נדה דף לט:) ריש ירחא וחמש בירחא תרי זימני, ובשלישי חמש בירחא ולא חזאי ריש ירחא, דקבעה לה וסת בה' בירחא ברביעית — קשה אליביה מתניתין לרבי יוחנן? וי"ל דאיהו יפרש מעין פתוח דחזאי שלשה זימני ריש ירחא וחמש בירחא. ולמאי דפריש לקמן דר"פ איירי דחזאי ג' זימנין ריש ירחא וחמש בירחא, דהאי נמי מקרי מעין סתום — יפרש מתני' מעין פתוח כפירוש אחר דרש"י, דפירש שראתה א' ב' ג' ד' רצופים בג' חדשים ראשונים:
Tosafot on Niddah 11a:12:1.english: From a stopped source - Rashi explained: For example, where she saw [blood] on the first of the month, and the first of the month, and the twenty-fifth of the month and the first of the month. And an open source is where the first sightings of the fixed cycle were within the days of menstruation (or the twenty-fifth of the month and the first of the month), or the first of the month and the fifth of the month, and similarly in the second and third [months] she saw on the fifth of the month and did not see on the first of the month. And if you ask: According to Rav Pappa, who explains at the end of [the chapter] Bnot Kutim (below, Niddah 39b) [that she saw] on the first of the month and the fifth of the month twice, and the third time on the fifth of the month and did not see on the first of the month, so that she established a fixed cycle on the fifth of the month in the fourth [month] — the Mishnah is difficult according to him, [as understood] by Rabbi Yohanan? And one can answer that he [Rabbi Yohanan] would explain "open source" as where she saw three times on the first of the month and the fifth of the month. And according to what is explained below, that Rav Pappa is speaking of a case where she saw three times on the first of the month and the fifth of the month, and this too is called a stopped source — [Rabbi Yohanan] would explain the Mishnah's "open source" according to Rashi's other explanation, who explained that she saw on the first, second, third, [and] fourth consecutively in the first three months.

Tosafot on Niddah 11a:3:1.hebrew: אלא לקפיצות והתניא כו' - פרש"י: לקפיצות לחודייהו. וקשה, דאם כן לישני בסמוך "לא קבעה וסת לימים אלא לקפיצות לחודייהו", ולמה חוזר מסברתו? ובסמוך נמי, דפריך "לימים" — פשיטא, לישני דלא קבעה וסת לקפיצות לחודיה, כדקס"ד מעיקרא! ונראה לפרש: "אלא לקפיצות" — אף לקפיצות, דהיינו לימים עם קפיצות; אבל קפיצות לחודייהו פשיטא להש"ס דלא קבעה:
Tosafot on Niddah 11a:3:1.english: "Rather, for jumps"; "But isn't it taught," etc. - Rashi explained: [the cycle is established] for the jumps alone. But this is difficult, for if so, let [the Gemara] answer shortly afterward, "She did not establish a cycle for the days, but only for the jumps alone" — so why does it retreat from its [initial] reasoning? And also shortly afterward, where it asks about [the case of] "days" — [the answer] is obvious: let it answer that she did not establish a cycle for jumps alone, as it assumed at first! Rather, it appears to explain: "Rather, for jumps" means even for jumps, i.e., for days together with jumps; but jumps alone — it is obvious to the Talmud that she did not establish [a cycle]:

Tosafot on Niddah 11a:6:1.hebrew: קפצה וראתה - ג' זימני גרסי', כדאמרינן בגמרא [בהבא על יבמתו] (יבמות דף סד:), דבוסתות סתם לן תנא כרשב"ג לקמן פרק האשה (נדה דף סג.), דתנן: אין האשה קובעת וסת עד שתקבענו ג' פעמים:
Tosafot on Niddah 11a:6:1.english: She jumped and saw - We read [the text as] three times, as we say [in the Gemara] in [the chapter] Haba Al Yevimto (Yevamot 64b): that regarding [the laws of] fixed cycles, the Tanna has taught us anonymously in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, later in the chapter Ha'Isha (Niddah 63a), where we learned: A woman does not establish a fixed cycle until she has established it three times:

Tosafot on Niddah 11b:4:1.hebrew: ומשמשת בעדים - אארבע נשים ואאשה שיש לה וסת קאי:
Tosafot on Niddah 11b:4:1.english: And she engages in intercourse with examination cloths - This refers to the four [categories of] women, and to a woman who has a fixed cycle:
